name: Grand Velas Riviera Maya
insider_take: This ultra-luxe all-inclusive resort spans three distinct environments - jungle, adults-only, and beachfront - each offering a completely different vibe within one spectacular property.
whats_special: Grand Velas is home to Mexico's first and only AAA Five Diamond all-inclusive resort, featuring multiple award-winning restaurants including Frida (Mexican fine dining) and Cocina de Autor (French cuisine). The property sits on pristine white sand beaches where ancient Mayan ruins dot the coastline, and guests can spot sea turtles nesting from May through October.
pro_tip: Book dinner at Cocina de Autor early - this French restaurant by celebrity chef Bruno Oteiza has a Michelin-trained team and only 40 seats, making it one of the most exclusive dining experiences in the Riviera Maya.
dont_miss: The SE Spa's seven-step hydrotherapy circuit featuring underground cenote-inspired pools, and snorkeling at the nearby Mesoamerican Reef - the second-largest coral reef system in the world, just minutes offshore.
pros: All-inclusive luxury resort with three distinct sections
Multiple award-winning restaurants and gourmet dining
Pristine beachfront location on Riviera Maya
cons: Large resort may feel less intimate
